The House

Made to remain.

Maison began in a single room above a Parisian courtyard in 2009, with one belief that has not moved since: a garment should outlast the season it was born in. We cut in wool and silk milled to last decades, finish every seam by hand, and release two considered collections a year — never more.

Nocturne is our winter answer. Sixty-two pieces, made between our atelier in Paris and a family mill in Florence, designed to be worn until they are worn out.

Hélène Marchand Founder &
Creative Director
